title: Why 'No Religion' Just Overtook The Catholics
hook: No religion now describes more Americans than any church does, except one.
closing: Younger adults are replacing older ones, so expect big changes for churches and communities.
question: Do you consider yourself religious?

segments.say: Once, only 8 percent of US adults had no religion. Today that share has more than tripled, and it's still climbing.
Among millennials, 36 percent have no religion, far more than the oldest generation. The shift is led by the young.
Only Protestants, at 40 percent, still outnumber people with no religion. Catholics are now third.
